import unittest
from counter import Counter


class CounterTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_click_counts(self):
        counter = Counter()
        counter.click()
        self.assertEqual(counter.value, 1)

    def test_reset(self):
        counter = Counter()
        counter.click()
        counter.reset()
        self.assertEqual(counter.value, 0)
